name: Quanttix Negotiation
description: Autonomous AR/AP negotiation agent over Telegram. Replaces the legacy Python handoff_server with a native OpenClaw extension: HTTP route, tools, inbound-claim hook, and Redis-backed cross-process binding store.

mode.description: Rollout mode. 'disabled' is inert. 'shadow' creates negotiations server-side but never sends Telegram. 'active' is the full path.

backendBaseUrl.description: Quanttix Django backend base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8001).

redisUrl.description: Redis connection string used for chat↔negotiation binding store.

agentId.description: OpenClaw agent id assigned by the inbound-claim hook when a chat has an active negotiation.

bindingTtlSeconds.description: TTL for chat↔negotiation binding entries (default 7 days, matching legacy handoff_server).
